Before you go, one little thing

Wait… are you sure?

A note from the heart♡

Hey, you.

I’m sorry for the things I said. They were hurtful, and you deserved more thought and kindness from me. I take responsibility for my words.

I don’t want my careless words to become the way you see yourself. Your feelings matter. Your voice deserves to be heard, and you deserve to be spoken to with respect.

You don’t have to be anything other than yourself to deserve kindness.

I hope you feel beautiful in your own way, appreciated for who you are, and comfortable saying how you really feel. I’m sorry I didn’t give you that care in our conversation.

I’ll be more careful with my words, listen instead of getting defensive, and respect whatever time you need. You don’t owe me forgiveness because I made this. I just wanted my apology to come with a little effort, too.

With a sincere sorry, and a little hope. ♡

Your answer is yours. I’ll respect it.

A very happy heart, right here

Thank you for
forgiving meee!

That means a lot to me. I’ll put the care I’ve put into this little page into my words and actions, too.

Here’s to kinder words & softer moments ♡

No rush. No pressure.

I hear you.
Take your time.

Thank you for being honest. My apology still stands, and I’ll respect your space. You don’t need to reply.

You deserve care, whatever your answer.
